classification: Packaging-tool configuration; not an application defect
archive_override_status: 41 unchanged CRLF working files reported modified
cause: The helper passed core.autocrlf=false to all Git calls, including status, rather than only archive. This changed the interpretation of checked-out text.
correction: Use normal Git settings for status/diff. Pass -c core.autocrlf=false only to git archive; compare archive bytes with committed blobs. No global configuration change.
evidence_kind: Actual tool traceback excerpt and read-only diagnosis, followed by executed canonical-archive retest; no terminal screenshot.
